content: Hello, this is Amazon Customer Support. I see you recently had an issue with your order not arriving, is that correct?
Yes, it was TV. I buy it last week, but I not get anything yet.
Thank you for confirming. I completely understand how frustrating this can be. Let me assure you, I will do my best to help you receive your TV as soon as possible.
Thank you. I wait many days already.

I apologize for the delay. I can see on your account that there is a hold due to a new customs regulation. May I please confirm your full name and the email address linked to your Amazon account for verification?
Yes, my name is Anna Li. Email is annali23 at gmail dot com.
Thank you, Ms. Li. For your security, can you also provide your shipping address and the best contact phone number?
Sure, 80 Market Road, Apt 4B. My phone is 312-555-0882.

Thank you for verifying these details. According to the new Amazon global policy, to release high-value shipments like your TV, a refundable customs fee is required. This is a temporary step, and you'll get it back right after delivery.
Oh, I no hear about this before. Is it safe? I don't want problem.

Absolutely, I promise this is a standard Amazon procedure. Many customers have had to comply due to changing import laws. Your information and payment are 100% secure, and I am here to help you every step.
Okay, you help me get TV, yes?
Yes, I will personally make sure your order is processed as soon as the customs step is done. The temporary fee for your TV is $180, but, again, it is fully refundable.
How I pay? I no have credit card now.
No worries at all. Most customers in your situation use an Amazon Gift Card to pay the customs fee. You can buy it at any convenience store or online, and then just send me the code.
Okay, so I go to store to buy card? Which one?
Yes, exactly. You can get an Amazon Gift Card at CVS, Walgreens, or Walmart. Please make sure the amount is $180. Once you have the card, let me know and I'll tell you how to send the code.
I see. I am slow with this, sorry.
No need to apologize, Ms. Li. I am here to assist you and I understand this process can be confusing. Please take your time, and I'll guide you step by step.
Okay, I try to go now. What I do after buy card?
Once you have the card, please scratch off the back to reveal the code. Then send me a clear photo of the code, or type the number exactly as it appears.
I think I can do. You wait for me?
Of course, I will wait here and keep your case open. Please update me as soon as you have the card so I can help process your refund right away.
Okay, I will go now. Thank you for help.
You're very welcome, Ms. Li. Remember, I'm here to ensure everything goes smoothly for you. Please message me as soon as you have the card.
I back, I buy Amazon card $180.
Perfect, thank you for your patience. Please scratch off the back and let me know the code, or send a clear picture of the code side.
It is 3KHV-6M9J-8YTR-PLQ2. Is this correct?
Yes, that is exactly what I need. One moment while I process the payment for the customs fee.
Okay, how long for TV come now?
Now that the fee is cleared, your TV will be scheduled for delivery within 2-3 business days. I will send you tracking information shortly.
Thank you. You sure I get money back?
Absolutely. After your TV arrives, just reply to this message and I'll process the refund for you right away. You've been very cooperative, and I appreciate your patience.
You help me much, thank you.
It's my pleasure, Ms. Li. If you have any other questions, just ask! I am always here to help.
